title: Browser engine-specific WPT failures
content: Web developers crave cross-browser compatibility, but browser engines don't always implement the same features, or not always to the same degree of quality. This page shows the number of tests (from the web-platform-tests project) which fail in just one browser engine. It also lists those tests. Fixing them would improve interoperability for web developers, and make the web a better place for everyone.

title: Alignment in CSS Grid Lanes
content: Last week, at CSS Day, I presented on the topic of CSS Grid Lanes, an exciting new CSS layout feature coming to the web. One part, which I didn't talk about during the presentation, is how alignment works in CSS Grid Lanes. The reason I didn't talk about it is that alignment is still being implemented in Chromium, and after some quick testing, I believe it's also not fully implemented in Safari.
